messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that translates Java code to GNU C++11 code. The code should reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<translated_code>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <stack>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cctype>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

// Global variables
int R, C;
vector<vector<ll>> rows;
int cntA[61], cntB[61];
ll best = 1LL << 62; // Large number
string str;
unordered_map<ll, ll> cache;

// Fast I/O
int readInt() {
    int ans = 0;
    bool neg = false;
    bool start = false;
    int c;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (c == '-') {
            start = true;
            neg = true;
            continue;
        } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            start = true;
            ans = ans * 10 + (c - '0');
        } else if (start) break;
    }
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
}

ll readLong() {
    ll ans = 0;
    bool neg = false;
    bool start = false;
    int c;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (c == '-') {
            start = true;
            neg = true;
            continue;
        } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            start = true;
            ans = ans * 10 + (c - '0');
        } else if (start) break;
    }
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
}

string readString() {
    string b;
    bool start = false;
    int c;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (!isspace(c)) {
            start = true;
            b.push_back((char)c);
        } else if (start) break;
    }
    return b;
}

void computeBinomial(int maxN) {
    rows.clear();
    rows.resize(maxN + 1);
    for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; i++) {
        rows[i].resize(i + 1);
        rows[i][0] = rows[i][i] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
            rows[i][j] = rows[i-1][j-1] + rows[i-1][j];
        }
    }
}

struct Frame {
    ll x, y;
    int v1, v2;
    Frame(ll x, ll y, int v1, int v2) : x(x), y(y), v1(v1), v2(v2) {}
};

void dfs(ll x, ll y, int v1, int v2) {
    stack<Frame> st;
    st.push(Frame(x, y, v1, v2));
    while (!st.empty()) {
        Frame f = st.top(); st.pop();
        ll diff = llabs(f.x - f.y);
        if (best <= 1 || diff - rows[f.v1][R] * rows[f.v2][R] >= best) continue;
        if (f.v1 == R - 1 && f.v2 == R - 1) {
            if (diff < best) best = diff;
            continue;
        }
        if (f.v2 >= R) {
            ll cur = rows[f.v2][R] - rows[f.v2 - 1][R];
            ll other = rows[f.v1][R];
            st.push(Frame(f.x + cur * other, f.y, f.v1, f.v2 - 1));
        }
        if (f.v1 >= R) {
            ll cur = rows[f.v1][R] - rows[f.v1 - 1][R];
            ll other = rows[f.v2][R];
            st.push(Frame(f.x, f.y + cur * other, f.v1 - 1, f.v2));
        }
    }
}

ll solve(ll x, ll y, int v1, int v2) {
    ll diff = llabs(x - y);
    if (diff - rows[v1][R] * rows[v2][R] > best) return 0;
    ll key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
    auto it = cache.find(key);
    if (it != cache.end()) return it->second;
    if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
        if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
            int sum = v1 + v2;
            v1 -= cntA[sum];
            v2 -= cntB[sum];
            return rows[v1 + v2][v1];
        }
        return 0;
    }
    ll ans = 0;
    char c = str[v1 + v2 - 1];
    if (c != 'B') {
        ll cur = rows[v1][R] - rows[v1 - 1][R];
        ll other = rows[v2][R];
        ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1 - 1, v2);
    }
    if (c != 'A') {
        ll cur = rows[v2][R] - rows[v2 - 1][R];
        ll other = rows[v1][R];
        ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2 - 1);
    }
    cache[key] = ans;
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    R = readInt();
    C = readInt();
    int maxN = 2 * (R + C);
    computeBinomial(maxN);
    ll x = 0, y = 0;
    int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
    while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R) {
        if (x > y) {
            ll cur = rows[v1][R] - rows[v1 - 1][R];
            ll other = rows[v2][R];
            y += cur * other;
            v1--;
        } else {
            ll cur = rows[v2][R] - rows[v2 - 1][R];
            ll other = rows[v1][R];
            x += cur * other;
            v2--;
        }
    }
    best = llabs(x - y);
    dfs(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
    str = readString();
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R + C); i++) {
        cntA[i + 1] = cntA[i] + (str[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
        cntB[i + 1] = cntB[i] + (str[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    ll ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
    printf("%lld\n", ans);
    fflush(stdout);
    return 0;
}
